visual_audit.scope: All 13 RF static camera cases inspected at K8, plus targeted K4/K8 details on RF2/RF4/RF8, both program controls, and actual-quarry stress captures. No motion or transparency acceptance.
observations: RF1: red and blue off-screen targets are present in the puddles at all three pitches; mirror positions align. Glossy boundaries retain visible quadrature grain and edge/pixel-integration error.
RF2: spheres and shadows remain present; K4/K8 glossy shapes and bright-point coverage differ from the reference. Rough/dielectric bands retain lighting bias; no final-floor acceptance.
RF3/RF5: inspected static centres only; the occluder and reflected target remain spatially plausible. This does not test reveal, trails, moving light response or recovery.

RF4: rails/poles and reflected thin features are present at the inspected larger scales. The detail crop shows single-frame aliasing and noisy glossy feature boundaries; subpixel/motion stability is not certified.
RF6: grazing mirror geometry remains present; bright reference sampling noise makes close HDR ranking unsafe.
RF7: the omitted recursive red reflection is clearly visible in the error panel. One reflection bounce cannot reproduce the facing-panel reference.
RF8: substantial missing crevice/bounce light and rough reflection differences remain. K8 does not repair the transport model.
RF9: the open shell is seen from its back in the mirror; reflected colour/illumination bias remains.

RF10: the toon subject is shaded with its own program in the reflection; its bands differ with local reflected view as in the reference. Ground/glossy noise and reference HDR convergence remain limits.

Program sheets: reflected and independent camera/native-primary images align visually; numerical checks cover all channels. The oracle fixture is a coloured planar target, with no silhouette/motion certification.
Actual quarry: all three stress frames render the scan geometry and texture; the constant sky/exposure is deliberately unmatched, so darkness or similarity does not establish quality acceptance.
